name: purs-graphs
description: PureScript FFI bindings for graph visualization (dagre + viz.js) with Halogen examples

scripts.test: spago test --config packages/purs-dagre/spago.yaml && spago test --config packages/purs-viz/spago.yaml
scripts.build:examples: cd examples/dagre-demo && spago build && npx vite build && cd ../viz-demo && spago build && npx vite build
scripts.format: purs-tidy format-in-place src test packages examples && biome check --write .
scripts.check: purs-tidy check src test packages examples
